verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a no-cost Lite plan for any single user, but it is described only as covering "essential smart time blocking features". Scheduling Links (shareable booking links) are documented as a product feature, but nothing here ties them to the free plan, so a usable free booking link is inferred rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Scheduling Links are included in Lite, any limits on free-tier links (count, durations, branding), independent or hands-on evidence of free-tier booking use.
